text_block_list.text:
In an Arima Kinen contested by many noble 
runners, Marvelous Sunday brilliantly 
triumphed in a legendary showdown for the 
ages.

What she wanted to convey through this 
race— breathing, feeling a pulse... living 
alongside everyone in this world full of 
miracles, joy, and wonder.

Through this race, she made sure to show 
everyone just how dazzlingly bright the 
world can truly shine.

The Marvelous that Marvelous Sunday had 
poured her whole heart into sharing had 
undeniably moved people's hearts.
